Alex: Heads-up: PR #4321 (fix: cache eviction) is failing CI on main. Failing test: test_cache_eviction (snapshot mismatch + occasional timeout). GH: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4321 CI: https://ci.redwood/100023 CI Bot: build #100023 failed — 2 failed tests. Tests failing: packages/runtime/test/eviction.test.ts::test_cache_eviction (timeout 30s), packages/ui/__snapshots__/console.snap mismatch. retry: /ci/retry 100023 Sam: @Alex thanks. Can you rerun? if flaky we can retry and merge if green :eyes: Alex: Already tried local `yarn test packages/runtime -t eviction --runInBand` — passes for me. Suspect snapshot drift from recent i18n changes. Jia: I saw a flake yesterday too. On arm nodes it timed out intermittently. Maybe increase timeout or mock timers? +1 to retry first. Lucas: If it's snapshot mismatch we should avoid blindly updating. ask: which snapshot file changed? @Alex paste the diff. Alex: diff snippet: ```diff -
Cached 3 items
+
Cached 2 items
``` Looks like a real change — my change adjusted eviction criteria. I updated snapshot locally with `yarn test -u` but didn't push. Maria: Don't push snapshot update until tests are stable. Suggest: rerun CI once, if passes merge; if fails, push a targeted snapshot update with PR description and QA flagged. Sam: /ci retry 100023 — kicked CI Bot: retry started — job 100023-rerun (queued on linux-x86). CI Bot: retry finished — 1 failed (test_cache_eviction). Flaky across two runs. Timeout is at 30s. Recommend to increase to 60s or stub timers. Jia: I can reproduce under stress. Changing to runInBand helps but doesn't represent CI. Could we stub Date/Timers in the test to make deterministic? I can open a follow-up PR. Alex: For current PR, I'd prefer to update snapshot for the intended DOM change and mark test for follow-up stabilization. Plan: push snapshot update in this branch, add TODO to create ticket to stabilize test. Lucas: Ok but need approval from @Sam for snapshot update on main-critical UI. @Sam? Sam: I'm fine approving if you include a test-stabilization ticket and add a note in PR description. Also add label `ci-flaky` and `qa-needed`. Alex: Done: updated snapshots, added ticket RED-5027, updated PR description, added labels. Pushed. CI Bot: build #100024 started (after push). CI Bot: build #100024 — all checks passed :white_check_mark: Maria: :tada: Nice. @Alex go ahead and merge when ready. I'll watch for any regression in console snapshots. Alex: Merging now. Thanks all :bow: Sam: :thumbsup: We'll follow up on RED-5027 next sprint.
